Per-cell evidence on the MEDICC2 pieces: depth and oriented molecule votes

Source: R/medicc2_cells.R
cell_piece_data.Rd

Depth (the per-cell analogue of clone_profiles()): the cell's 1 Mb window counts summed over the piece (windows fully inside it; region_features()), log2ratio = log2((x + 0.5) / (e + 0.5)) relative to the reference pool's pseudobulk of the piece (ref_center = "pseudobulk", log2((sum x + 0.5) / (sum e + 0.5)) over the reference cells, as the clone profiles; "mean" = the mean of the reference cells' log2 ratios, as assign_cells(), which a few reference cells with a large negative offset pull down), then (center) minus the cell's own baseline: the window-weighted median of its log2 ratios over the autosomal pieces (the clone profiles are centred on the clone's autosomal median in the same way, so states are relative to the baseline). SD: the cell's null SD of the piece's size class (sd_null of the piece's sd_class); with sd_scale, a piece shorter than its tile class (e.g. a 2 Mb piece scored with the 5 Mb SD) gets sd_null * sqrt(class size / covered window length) (the independent-window limit); pieces on haploid chromosomes get haploid_sd x that; s_sys (systematic depth bias of a region between the scored cells and the reference pool, the clone model's s_sys) is added in quadrature: sd = sqrt(sd_scaled^2 + s_sys^2). z = log2ratio / pmax(sd, sd_floor); pieces without a window have NA depth (no evidence). Alleles: the cell's molecule votes on the piece (atom start in [start, end)) per phase set, oriented by the block table: oA = votes of the cn_a haplotype (nA when sign > 0, nB when sign < 0), oN = oriented votes. With loo, the reference clone's pooled votes are first reduced by the cell's own votes when the cell was one of the cells that oriented the block (loo maps cells to the clone whose pool they joined; only blocks whose ref is that clone are affected): the orientation is then the one the other cells give, and the cell's own votes cannot confirm themselves. This is the only use of a cell's clone membership, and it only removes the cell's own data from the orientation input.

Usage

cell_piece_data(
  features,
  pieces,
  blocks,
  cells = NULL,
  ref_cells = NULL,
  loo = NULL,
  params = caller_defaults(),
  sd_scale = TRUE,
  ref_center = c("pseudobulk", "mean"),
  center = TRUE,
  s_sys = 0,
  haploid_sd = sqrt(2)
)

Arguments

features

scn_features list (win, long, regions, votes, atoms, cells; as the tumour mode reads it)

pieces

piece table (piece, chrom, start, end, one row per piece or per clone x piece)

blocks

block orientation (piece, ps, sign and, for loo, ref, nA_ref, nB_ref)

cells

cells to score (default all cells of features)

ref_cells

reference cells of the depth centring (>= 10 used; NULL = no centring)

loo

NULL, or data.table cell, clone: the cells whose votes formed each reference clone's pool

params

caller_defaults() (sd_floor)

sd_scale

scale the null SD of pieces shorter than their tile class

ref_center

reference centring: pseudobulk or mean

center

subtract the cell's autosomal median (window-weighted over pieces)

s_sys

systematic SD (log2) added in quadrature to the per-cell SD

haploid_sd

factor on the null SD of pieces on haploid chromosomes (male chrX / chrY): sd_null comes from diploid regions, and one copy gives half the fragments, so z on haploid pieces is overdispersed

Value

data.table cell, piece, x, e, n_win (1 Mb windows), log2ratio (centred), offset (the cell's subtracted baseline), sd_null, sd, z, stratum, sd_class, n_frag, oA, oN, n_blocks (oriented phase sets with votes)
